declarations.type:
∀ {PolicyDigest : Type} (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumSystem)
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.VoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumCertificate system PolicyDigest),
  left.term = right.term →
    left.index = right.index →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.CertificateValid system ledger left →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.CertificateValid system ledger right →
          left.receipt = right.receipt
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.valid_same_slot_certificates_bind_same_receipt

declarations.type:
∀ {PolicyDigest : Type} (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumSystem)
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.VoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumCertificate system PolicyDigest),
  ¬system.isQuorum certificate.signers →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.CertificateValid system ledger certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.nonquorum_certificate_is_not_valid

declarations.type:
∀ {PolicyDigest : Type} (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumSystem)
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.VoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumCertificate system PolicyDigest)
  (node : system.Node),
  node ∈ certificate.signers →
    ledger node certificate.term certificate.index ≠ some certificate.receipt →
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.CertificateValid system ledger certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.inconsistent_signer_vote_invalidates_certificate

declarations.type:

  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.VoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.QuorumCertificate system PolicyDigest),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.CertificateValid system ledger certificate →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.RecoverableCommittedReceipt system ledger
      certificate.term certificate.index certificate.receipt

declarations.type:

  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.VoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (term : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.ConsensusTerm)
  (index : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumCertificate.LogIndex)
  (leftReceipt rightReceipt :
